---
title: "Presupuestos"
---

```{=html}
<div class="tf-page-header">
  <div>
    <h1>Presupuestos</h1>
    <div class="tf-muted">Control mensual por categoría y subcategoría, con rollover y alertas de consumo.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="tf-actions">
    <button id="budget-new" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">+ Nuevo presupuesto</button>
    <button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button>
  </div>
</div>

<section class="tf-card tf-budget-overview">
  <div class="tf-budget-period-nav" aria-label="Mes visible">
    <button id="budget-prev" type="button" class="tf-icon-button" aria-label="Mes anterior">‹</button>
    <button id="budget-period-label" type="button" class="tf-budget-period-label">Noviembre 2026</button>
    <button id="budget-next" type="button" class="tf-icon-button" aria-label="Mes siguiente">›</button>
  </div>
  <button id="budget-current" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary tf-btn-compact" type="button" hidden>Ir al mes actual</button>

  <div class="tf-budget-summary-grid">
    <div class="tf-metric"><span class="tf-metric-label">Presupuestado</span><strong id="budget-summary-available">$0,00</strong></div>
    <div class="tf-metric"><span class="tf-metric-label">Gastado</span><strong id="budget-summary-spent">$0,00</strong></div>
    <div class="tf-metric"><span class="tf-metric-label">Disponible</span><strong id="budget-summary-remaining">$0,00</strong></div>
    <div class="tf-metric"><span class="tf-metric-label">Uso</span><strong id="budget-summary-use">0%</strong></div>
  </div>
  <div class="tf-budget-progress" aria-hidden="true"><span id="budget-summary-progress"></span></div>
</section>

<section class="tf-card" style="margin-top:1rem">
  <div class="tf-section-heading">
    <div>
      <h2 id="budget-list-title">Presupuestos del mes</h2>
      <div class="tf-muted">Las alertas aparecen cuando queda 30%, 10% o cuando el presupuesto se sobrepasa.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="budget-list" class="tf-budget-list"></div>
</section>

<dialog id="budget-editor" class="tf-modal-dialog tf-budget-editor-dialog">
  <div class="tf-modal-head tf-budget-editor-head">
    <div>
      <div class="tf-section-kicker">Presupuesto mensual</div>
      <h2 id="budget-editor-title">Nuevo presupuesto</h2>
    </div>
    <button id="budget-editor-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary tf-btn-compact" type="button">Cerrar</button>
  </div>

  <form id="budget-form" class="tf-budget-editor-form">
    <div class="tf-budget-editor-scroll">
      <div class="tf-field">
        <label>Mes del presupuesto</label>
        <button id="budget-editor-month-button" type="button" class="tf-picker-button"><span aria-hidden="true">📅</span><strong id="budget-editor-month-label">—</strong></button>
        <input id="budget-month" type="hidden" required>
      </div>

      <div class="tf-field">
        <label>Categoría y subcategoría</label>
        <button id="budget-category-picker" type="button" class="tf-tx-category-picker">Seleccionar categoría y subcategoría</button>
        <input id="budget-category" type="hidden">
        <input id="budget-subcategory" type="hidden">
      </div>

      <div class="tf-field">
        <label>Límite base mensual ($)</label>
        <div class="tf-account-opening-input-wrap">
          <span>$</span>
          <input id="budget-limit" type="text" inputmode="decimal" autocomplete="off" placeholder="0,00" required>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tf-check">
        <input id="budget-rollover" type="checkbox">
        <label for="budget-rollover">Arrastrar saldo positivo del mes anterior</label>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="tf-budget-save-bar">
      <button id="budget-cancel" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cancelar</button>
      <button id="budget-submit" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="submit">Guardar presupuesto</button>
    </div>
  </form>
</dialog>

<dialog id="budget-category-dialog" class="tf-tx-category-dialog">
  <div class="tf-tx-category-dialog-head">
    <div>
      <div class="tf-section-kicker">Clasificación</div>
      <h3 id="budget-category-dialog-title">Seleccionar categoría</h3>
    </div>
    <button id="budget-category-dialog-close" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cerrar</button>
  </div>
  <div id="budget-category-dialog-body" class="tf-tx-category-options"></div>
</dialog>

<dialog id="budget-month-dialog" class="tf-tx-category-dialog tf-budget-month-dialog">
  <div class="tf-tx-category-dialog-head">
    <div>
      <div class="tf-section-kicker">Período</div>
      <h3>Seleccionar mes</h3>
    </div>
    <button id="budget-month-dialog-close" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cerrar</button>
  </div>
  <div class="tf-budget-year-nav">
    <button id="budget-year-prev" type="button" class="tf-icon-button" aria-label="Año anterior">‹</button>
    <strong id="budget-picker-year">2026</strong>
    <button id="budget-year-next" type="button" class="tf-icon-button" aria-label="Año siguiente">›</button>
  </div>
  <div id="budget-month-grid" class="tf-budget-month-grid"></div>
  <div class="tf-actions" style="margin-top:.8rem"><button id="budget-picker-current" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Mes actual</button></div>
</dialog>

<dialog id="budget-detail-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog tf-budget-detail-dialog">
  <div class="tf-modal-head">
    <div>
      <div class="tf-section-kicker">Detalle del presupuesto</div>
      <h2 id="budget-detail-title">Presupuesto</h2>
    </div>
    <button id="budget-detail-close" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary tf-btn-compact">Cerrar</button>
  </div>
  <div id="budget-detail-body" class="tf-budget-detail-body"></div>
</dialog>

<script type="module" src="js/budgets-v1.js?v=1.0.83"></script>
```
